method: Fresh native checks on the same eight distinct proof tasks per prover, with two trials per worker cap and reversed worker order on the second trial. Baseline and optimized snapshots ran successively with affinity to eight CPUs on one shared host. The snapshots differed only in the hash index implementation. Native build identities, task inputs and all observed outcomes were compared. No result cache was used. The Metamath stress trials used the host's default CPU affinity.
comparison_command: python -m benchmarks.runtime.scale --prefix PREFIX --provers metamath rocq acl2 --count 8 --trials 2 --output FILE
